Editorial Policy

Lighter Together is run and edited by its owner. The site is an educational resource and a peer community. It is not a medical service.

How we write

  • Guides are written in plain language and based on recognised public health sources, which are listed at the end of each article where possible.
  • We do not claim that articles are reviewed by doctors unless a named professional has actually done so.
  • We do not sell treatments or accept payment to recommend products.

Community content

Stories, questions and replies are written by members and reflect personal experience only. They are not medical advice. See the Community Rules.

Corrections

If you find an error or outdated information, email oudjanifarid4@gmail.com and we will review and correct it.
